metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2015 · Making a Murderer

metas.description: A group of online justice seekers track down a guy who posted a video of himself killing kittens.

metas.name: ★ 8.6 · 2015 · The Jinx: The Life and Deaths of Robert Durst
